items.title: Solana flirts with $100 despite rising competition – Can SOL unlock 20% more?
items.whyYouShouldCare: Solana's price nearing $100 indicates strong market interest, but increased competition could impact its ability to sustain or grow this valuation.

items.title: Solana’s first governance vote nears with a live 60% quorum display error
items.whyYouShouldCare: The upcoming governance vote highlights Solana's evolving ecosystem, but the quorum display error raises concerns about the reliability of its governance mechanisms.

items.title: Solana cuts mainnet slot time to 350 milliseconds in first step toward 200ms goal
items.whyYouShouldCare: Reducing mainnet slot time to 350 milliseconds is a strategic move to enhance transaction speed, positioning Solana for improved scalability and user experience.
